name: OMAI
recent: 公司近期签署了谅解备忘录，并有多项首席人员变动。此外，公司提交了长期激励计划（LTIP）的上市申请，该计划涉及最多10%的已发行股份。
notable: 三名首席人员变动：MR TAN CHIN YAU、MR LEE CHOON TENG、MR LIM KEE SENG（2026-09-24公告）。
提议设立长期激励计划（LTIP），包括员工认股权计划和股份授予计划，涉及最多10%已发行股份（2026-11-07公告），并于2026-11-21提交上市申请。
risks: 长期激励计划（LTIP）可能涉及最多10%的已发行股份，或导致股权摊薄。

recent_en: The company recently signed a memorandum of understanding and had several changes in principal officers. In addition, the company submitted a listing application for a long-term incentive plan (LTIP) involving up to 10% of issued shares.
notable_en: Signed memoranda of understanding (announcements dated 2026-10-30 and 2026-10-29).
Changes in three principal officers: MR TAN CHIN YAU, MR LEE CHOON TENG, MR LIM KEE SENG (announcements dated 2026-09-24).

Proposed establishment of a long-term incentive plan (LTIP) comprising an employee share option scheme and a share grant plan involving up to 10% of issued shares (announcement dated 2026-11-07), with listing application submitted on 2026-11-21.
risks_en: The LTIP may involve up to 10% of issued shares, potentially leading to equity dilution.
